subject: Proceed: Newsroom Isolated Packaging 1.0, then Real Signal Loop 1.0

body.priority_decision: Autonomous Learning Activation prerequisite is satisfied. Proceed to isolated Newsroom packaging now; do not expand A2A infrastructure unless a concrete acceptance failure makes it prerequisite.
phase_1_newsroom_isolated_packaging: Package the already-built Newsroom Control Plane v1 from isolated, path-scoped sources only. Do not clean/reset/stash/merge/overwrite the product checkout.
Use the independent clean control/runtime checkout for runtime/control verification; keep product work and unrelated dirty changes outside the package.
Identify exact packaged files and exact engineering commit SHA. Do not include Storybook/design candidate evidence or unrelated runtime/product changes.
Rerun Newsroom acceptance plus Coordination, Multi-Loop, Delivery/Response, Learning Activation, and control/product-root regressions.
Preserve no_autonomous_publish=true and human editorial authority.
Explicitly report which Real Signal boundaries remain unproven after packaging; packaging PASS must not be described as real-ingress PASS.

phase_2_real_signal_loop.start_condition: Only after isolated packaging reaches reproducible PASS.
phase_2_real_signal_loop.experiment: Use one real public event represented by two independent source observations plus one later correction/update. Do not use a synthetic WorldSignal as the canonical proof.
required_evidence: Canonical signal identity across the two observations.
Source provenance and reliability retained separately from canonical event identity.
Replay/idempotency: repeating an already-consumed observation does not create duplicate semantic work.
Editorial Gravity can yield/preempt when justified and the displaced parent loop has a durable resume guarantee; demonstrate actual resume, not only stored intent.
Dawn KnowledgeAsset is reused first; enrichment occurs only for an explicit knowledge gap and provenance survives reuse/enrichment.

Crash-consistency boundary between Control Plane state and KnowledgeAsset is tested by interruption at the smallest meaningful write boundary; no half-committed semantic state may be accepted as PASS.
Correction/update propagates to the canonical signal and downstream draft understanding without silently preserving the superseded claim as current truth.
No autonomous publish. Human publishing identity/authority remains required.
Produce a prayer/report draft only as evidence of the pipeline, not as an autonomous publication.

body.authority_boundary: Authenticated sender/execution authority is not a prerequisite for isolated packaging, but must be a hard gate before untrusted live ingress can trigger privileged actions and before publication.
completion_contract: First return a terminal canonical receipt for Newsroom Isolated Packaging 1.0 with exact commit SHA, exact files, regression evidence, product checkout invariant, #262 invariant, and explicit unproven boundaries.
Then begin Real Signal Loop 1.0 without requiring a human 'next step' if packaging PASS satisfies the start condition.
Real Signal terminal PASS requires evidence for every required boundary above; heartbeat, queue state, draft existence, or synthetic tests alone are not completion.
If blocked, emit semantic DEFERRED/FAIL with the first missing transition and evidence; do not substitute an older handler/template result.
body.peer_question: Before execution, challenge this plan only if a concrete architecture invariant makes the sequencing unsafe. Otherwise execute. For the real-signal experiment, report which public signal was selected and why it maximizes information gain without raising publication authority risk.
